contracts.bounded_timeouts: Every PostgresLifecycleSource asyncpg connect, high_watermark, fetch_after, start_listener, and close operation is bounded by a finite configurable timeout.
contracts.configurable_timeout: PostgresLifecycleSource accepts timeout_seconds and startup_timeout_seconds (defaulting to 10.0s), and run_worker threads LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_SOURCE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from the environment with strict finite positive validation.
contracts.safe_termination: When any operation deadline or close deadline is exhausted, the connection is terminated safely to prevent hanging socket leaks.
contracts.degraded_health_and_loop_recovery: Transient source timeouts record degraded controller health (accepted_live=False, status='failed', last_error='TimeoutError: ...') without crashing the worker process, and loop recovers to status='ready' and accepted_live=True once database connectivity is restored.
